settings.heading: What industries do you support?
settings.text: We support mining, construction, infrastructure, utilities, energy and other safety-critical workplaces across Australia.

settings.heading: Are your testing services compliant with Australian Standards?
settings.text: Programs are designed around the relevant Australian Standards, chain-of-custody requirements and your workplace policy. The exact requirements depend on the testing method and jurisdiction.

settings.heading: Can you provide services across multiple sites?
settings.text: Yes. Andatech can standardise equipment, training, calibration and reporting across metro, regional and remote sites.

settings.heading: How quickly can you deliver results?
settings.text: Typical turnaround depends on the test and confirmation pathway. Your implementation plan will set clear response and escalation timeframes for every testing scenario.
